_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: Dual-biometric identity verification - face_recognition/dlib (ResNet-34) + Resemblyzer voice embeddings - cutting manual roll-call down to sub-500ms verification.
AI resume-analysis platform: FastAPI + Streamlit, spaCy/Sentence-Transformer semantic JD matching, and a Groq (Llama 3) layer for real-time LLM feedback.
NLP misinformation classifier - TF-IDF + Scikit-learn - 98.92% accuracy across 8,980 test samples, with OCR support for screenshot input.
MERN event-management platform built with a 4-person team; my slice was the React category-navigation components and REST API integrations.
